summary: All operations, welding parameters, dimensions, coating and tapping values match the golden and the header revision and dates are correct. It fails on the header stage number (PP-010 to PP-110 instead of 1) and on many PPAP-sourced additions not in the golden: SI/QP/585888210155 and PDI references, 1-per-lot and 5-per-shift sampling, 0.8 mm AWS 70 S 6 wire, SS 7265/7651, 80 RPM and vernier checks. Coating rework rejects parts instead of re-coating.
